findings.summary: Browser sessions performed repeated full-table reads for conflict detection and sync preparation.
evidence: src/context/CloudSyncContext.tsx polled refreshUpdates on an interval
src/services/assetManager.ts loaded full rows from categories, prompts, context_menus, and prompt_memory_context
findings.recommended_action: keep update checks metadata-only and stop timer-driven full hydration

findings.summary: A public Storage bucket exists in the same project, but the current app code does not reference Supabase Storage.
evidence: SQL inventory shows public bucket HIGGSFIELD with 5 objects totaling about 9447814 bytes
Repository grep found no storage.from/getPublicUrl/createSignedUrl/download/upload usage in the app code
findings.recommended_action: audit external access and confirm whether the public bucket is still required

findings.summary: Sensitive Supabase credentials exist in local env files.
evidence: .env and .env.local include service role and JWT-related variables
git ls-files shows these local env files are not currently tracked
findings.recommended_action: review exposure history and rotate credentials under a controlled change window if needed

root_cause.summary: Uncached egress is strongly explained by timer-driven full-table browser sync reads. Cached egress likely involves the public HIGGSFIELD bucket, but object-level access proof is still missing.

emergency: clear the administrative restriction by billing action appropriate to the actual plan
avoid restoring billing without the sync mitigation already applied in this branch
p0: disable periodic update polling when Realtime is healthy
switch conflict checks to metadata-only summaries
hydrate full rows only for confirmed diffs
p1: replace broad select star patterns in sync flows with explicit columns where possible
audit public bucket usage and visibility
p2: add usage monitoring and budget alerts
separate public media from app data if the public bucket remains necessary
